methods.label: Compute the reciprocals
methods.explanation:
The reciprocal of a nonzero number is the number that multiplies it to give \(1\). The listed numbers have reciprocals
\[
3,\quad \frac52,\quad 1,\quad \frac15,\quad \frac1{1986},
\]
respectively. Since \(5/2<3\) and the last three reciprocals are at most \(1\), the largest reciprocal is \(3\). It belongs to \(\boxed{\frac13}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
